mapper.insert: insert into roam_share_snapshot (share_token, member_id, client_ts, snapshot_json, create_time, update_time) values (#{shareToken}, #{memberId}, #{clientTs}, #{snapshotJson}, now(), now()) on duplicate key update snapshot_json = values(snapshot_json), update_time = values(update_time)

insert into roam_share_snapshot (share_token, member_id, client_ts, session_id, snapshot_json, create_time, update_time) values (#{shareToken}, #{memberId}, #{clientTs}, #{sessionId}, #{snapshotJson}, now(), now()) on duplicate key update session_id = values(session_id), snapshot_json = values(snapshot_json), update_time = values(update_time), version = version + 1
mapper.select: select version from roam_share_snapshot where member_id = #{memberId} and client_ts = #{clientTs}
select share_token from roam_share_snapshot where member_id = #{memberId} and client_ts = #{clientTs}
select count(*) from roam_share_snapshot where member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.delete: delete from roam_share_snapshot where member_id = #{memberId} order by update_time asc, id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.select: select p.snapshot_json from roam_share_snapshot p left join roam_session s on s.id = p.session_id and s.member_id = p.member_id where p.share_token = #{shareToken} and ((p.session_id is null and p.create_time > date_sub(now(), interval 30 day)) or (p.session_id is not null and s.status = 1 and s.finished_at > date_sub(now(), interval 30 day)))
mapper.delete: delete from roam_share_snapshot where member_id = #{memberId} and share_token = #{shareToken}
delete from roam_share_snapshot where session_id = #{sessionId} and member_id = #{memberId}

delete from roam_share_snapshot where (create_time is null or create_time <= #{cutoff}) and not exists(select 1 from roam_session s where s.id=roam_share_snapshot.session_id and s.member_id=roam_share_snapshot.member_id and (s.status=0 or (s.status=1 and s.finished_at > #{cutoff}))) order by id limit #{limit}
